IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, tousled brown
hair walks a runway in an oversized powder blue
wool coat with toggle fastenings and large patch
pockets. Beneath it, a dark brown pleated mini skirt
with a textured knit overlay, sheer brown tights, and
pale blue ribbed socks. Black pointed loafers
complete the look. Her expression is calm and
direct. A pale stone runway with warm wooden
walls. This is a duplicate of section 82.
